title: Project Blue Book case-file records - 595553
doc_notes: This document is a comic-style archival record from Project Blue Book detailing the July 1952 Washington D.C. radar sightings and the subsequent Air Force explanation.

incidents.summary: Multiple radar contacts and visual sightings of unidentified objects over Washington D.C. restricted airspace.
behavior: accelerated from 130 to 500 mph in 4 seconds
incidents.explanation: Air Force attributed sightings to temperature inversion causing radar reflections of ground objects.
incidents.quote: THEY PERFORMED GYRATIONS WHICH NO KNOWN AIRCRAFT COULD PERFORM.
